title: Administrator: cannot be edited to lose Administration-pages access
config: Create Custom Role -> Choose Administrator template -> attempt to disable Access Administration pages
expected: The custom role cannot be saved with Admin-pages access removed; Administrator always retains admin access.
actual: Choosing the Administrator template pre-fills the editor with all 42 permissions and shows a guard banner: "Full administrative access - This role has every permission enabled, giving it full administrative access. Make sure this is intended before saving." No discrete "Access Administration pages" permission exists in the catalog (settings access is split across settingsApp/Service/Finance/Parts/Wages/DataImport), so the specific locked/revert toggle described could not be located or exercised.
notes: Template-apply pre-fill from Administrator verified (all perms enabled + full-admin guard banner, footer button labelled "Create"). The exact "Admin-pages access" lock/revert-on-save behavior is not represented as a single toggle in this build; not confirmable without a matching permission. 2 focused editor attempts made.

title: Administrator: remove Work Orders Delete only (delta), rest of full access intact

expected: Only Work Orders Delete is removed; every other Administrator capability remains available to the user.
actual: Tech effective perms match target (40 perms). Removed: WO Delete.

title: Administrator: template list shows only expected full-access template
config: Create Custom Role > 'Choose a template' picker (GET /api/role-templates), no change
expected: Owner does not appear in the template list; Administrator is the only full-access template.
actual: Template picker lists 11 system templates (Admin, Foreman, Office, Parts Manager, Parts Tech, Sales Representative, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor, Service Manager, Technician, Time Clock). No 'Owner' entry present. 'Admin' (Administrator) is the only template described 'Full system access'.
notes: Verified via role-templates endpoint that backs the Choose-a-template picker.
